title: `nail search` leaves its `tmp-nail` directory behind after every run
body:
Without `--tmp-dir`, nail creates `./tmp-nail/<unix time in ns>/` (nail/src/args.rs) and writes the mmseqs dbs and `seeds.tsv` there. Nothing in nail deletes that directory at the end of a run. A survey of `dev` on 2026-11-02 found nine left after a few runs. On a large search they hold the prefilter and align dbs and the seeds file, which can be very large.

## Proposal

nail deletes a tmp directory it created once the run succeeds. A directory the user named with `--tmp-dir` stays.

## Open

- whether a failed run keeps its directory for debugging
- whether a `--keep-tmp` flag is wanted
